instructions: This template is for a REAL listed company and it must be filled in BY HAND from the published annual report. It cannot be generated, and it must not be filled in from a data provider's API — the entire point is to check the engine against an independent human reading of the primary source.
HOW TO USE IT (this is the PRD Phase 0 / Phase 1 exit-gate deliverable):
2. Open the company's annual report. Use CONSOLIDATED statements.
3. Enter every figure in rupees CRORE. If the report is in rupees million, divide by 10. If in lakh, divide by 100. Record whatever you did in _meta.unit_conversion.
4. Enter costs, capex, depreciation, interest and tax as POSITIVE magnitudes.
5. Check that total_assets equals total_liabilities plus shareholders_equity. The loader will flag it if not.
6. Compute each expected ratio BY HAND in Excel from these same figures. Do not run the engine first and copy its output — that would make the test circular and worthless.
7. Record each expected value below with the page of the annual report the inputs came from.

A deviation between your Excel value and the engine is informative either way. The usual causes, in order of frequency: consolidated vs standalone mismatch, a fiscal-year labelling difference, an average-vs-closing balance-sheet convention, or a genuine engine bug. Investigate before assuming the engine is wrong, and record the finding in docs/EVALUATION.md.
_meta.unit_conversion: e.g. report in Rs million; divided by 10 to reach Rs crore
_meta.basis_note: Consolidated. Note any restatement of the comparative year.

market.source: e.g. NSE closing price on the date above

roe.computed_from: PAT FY2026 / average of FY2026 and FY2025 shareholders' equity
roe.source: Annual Report FY2026 p.144 (P&L), p.146 (Balance Sheet)

ocf_to_pat.computed_from: Net cash from operating activities / PAT, FY2026
